brief: The 6 mindset shifts that separate people who get rich from people who stay broke.

slots.title: Buy Assets Not Liabilities
slots.body: Wealthy people acquire things that generate income. Broke people spend on items that drain money. One purchase builds your future while the other steals it.
slots.tipBody: Before any purchase over $100, ask if it pays you back.

slots.title: Stop Trading Time For Money
slots.body: Broke people sell hours. Rich people buy time by delegating, automating, and building systems. Your time is the only asset you cannot scale.
slots.tipBody: Calculate your hourly rate and delegate anything below it.

slots.title: Take Calculated Smart Risks
slots.body: Staying broke feels safe but guarantees poverty. Wealth requires educated bets with upside. Risk is the price of admission for real returns.
slots.tipBody: Never risk more than you can afford to lose completely.

slots.title: Adopt An Abundance Mindset
slots.body: Broke minds hoard and compete from fear. Rich minds collaborate and create value knowing there is plenty. Scarcity repels money; abundance attracts it.
slots.tipBody: Give value first without expecting immediate return.

slots.title: Invest In Skills First
slots.body: Poor people save every dollar. Rich people reinvest in knowledge, coaching, and networks. The fastest way to double income is to triple your value.
slots.tipBody: Spend ten percent of income on courses and coaching.

slots.title: Build Multiple Income Streams
slots.body: One paycheck is the most dangerous number in finance. Wealthy people stack three to five income sources. Security comes from diversity, not dependence.
slots.tipBody: Start one side income before you need it.

slots.body: Pick one shift and act on it today. Your future self will thank you.
